qualification_basis.blackbox: Official Terms section 5 says customer rights do not include software source code; bounded candidate search found no public buildable corresponding Android client. This supports treating the exact APK as black-box test input, not an exhaustive global absence proof.
qualification_basis.mainstream: Google Play listing for same package shows 100M+ downloads and 133K reviews at review time
qualification_basis.overseas: AnyDesk Software GmbH is German vendor; international official Android download and global remote-access product

review_scope: existing APK host-only readback plus current official public web pages; no payload re-download, device, container, Bridge or SSH
scope_limit: Qualification applies to test-input cohort, not successful cold start
No install behavior observed; targetSdk37 greater than AOSP16 API36 is risk, not failure
No source compiler identity can be inferred from the APK
Product popularity does not prove this exact binary release installed by 100M users
